**v1.9.0: the battle simulator plays Sharpen and Potent the bot's way.**
- **Sharpen and Potent.** The bot already puts a Sharpened Blade on a blade it casts (a Potent Trap on a trap): that blade's second, sharpened cast. The simulator now does the same. The first Sharpen (Potent) in your hand goes on the blade (trap) being cast while that blade's sharpened cast is free. It costs no pip and no turn and adds the card's +N% (10 when it has none) to each school the blade boosts. It never goes on a pet's or gear's copy, nor on the copy the bot casts instead when the first copy of that blade in your hand can't go (the bot casts that one plain), and a missed blade loses both. With `reboost` off, each blade and trap can go twice a battle, once plain and once sharpened: 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap against a 6000-health boss now casts Stormblade and Storm Trap 1.98 times a battle each (1.0 before), with 0.98 Sharpened Blade and 0.99 Potent Trap. Before, the simulator threw Sharpens and Potents away as cards it doesn't play.
- **The discards that come with them.** The bot's own DiscardSpare rules, now in the simulator too. A blade whose plain and sharpened casts both went, with no copy in hand that can still go: its copies in hand are thrown away when `discardspent` didn't settle them. A spare Sharpen is thrown once a blade was sharpened and no blade in your hand can still take one. Both run as a Hitter with `discardunused` on or off, up to 3 of a blade (and 3 Sharpens) a round, not counted in `discardmax`, and never take a treasure card or a pet's or gear's card: when the first one in hand is such a card, nothing goes, as with the bot's right-click. A Potent is kept all battle. With `useblades` off, `discardunused` throws the Sharpens away (with `usetraps` off, the Potents).
- **Measured on the same dice** (2000 battles a cell, each battle on the same seed in v1.8.1 and v1.9.0): a Storm wizard with 3000 health and 60% damage against a 6000-health boss or 3 mobs of 1500 health (2-pip hits of 150-200 and 100-150 that always land). % won v1.8.1 -> v1.9.0 with `discardspent` on (this AutoFarmer's default), then off (an older AutoFarmer's), then with `reboost` on; in brackets, the battles only v1.9.0 won / only v1.8.1 won:
  - 8 Storm Lord + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade against the boss: 90.6% -> 92.2% (+153 / -120); 90.6% -> 92.3% (+153 / -119); 93.0% -> 93.7% (+117 / -105).
  - The same against 3 mobs: 27.4% -> 34.2% (+448 / -311); 27.4% -> 34.5% (+450 / -307); 64.3% -> 44.5% (+237 / -633).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap against the boss: 93.5% -> 96.9% (+123 / -56); 56.9% -> 89.0% (+701 / -59); 97.7% -> 97.2% (+26 / -35).
  - The same against 3 mobs: 31.9% -> 44.4% (+570 / -320); 21.0% -> 41.4% (+604 / -197); 81.2% -> 75.3% (+236 / -353).
  - 4 Storm Lord + 4 Tempest + 3 Stormblade + 3 Storm Trap + 2 Feint + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap against the boss: 82.3% -> 96.7% (+332 / -45); 80.7% -> 95.4% (+346 / -52); 97.7% -> 96.8% (+40 / -58).
  - The same against 3 mobs: 81.9% -> 90.9% (+287 / -107); 78.2% -> 90.5% (+352 / -108); 89.3% -> 89.9% (+173 / -162).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 1 Stormblade + 1 Sharpened Blade, the same under all three: the boss 90.9% -> 90.2% (+24 / -39); 3 mobs 25.7% -> 24.2% (+49 / -78).
  - 10 Thunder Snake + 6 Storm Lord + 4 Sharpened Blade (no blade), the same under all three: the boss 81.2% -> 76.2% (+188 / -289); 3 mobs 22.6% -> 18.9% (+49 / -123).
- **Worth knowing.** With `reboost` on against mobs, decks with Sharpens can win less (64.3% -> 44.5% for the first deck above). Most of that is the bot's DiscardSpare, which doesn't look at `reboost`: once a blade's plain and sharpened casts both went, its both-casts rule throws the blade's other copies away, though the hit would have let them go again (57.0% in the simulator with that rule off, 52.9% with its spare-Sharpen rule off too). The simulator plays it as the bot does; that fix belongs in the bot, as a separate change. The rest is the Sharpen played at all, as the bot plays it: with boost first, a blade's second, sharpened cast is one more boosting round before a hit. None of the second deck's drop (81.2% -> 75.3%) is DiscardSpare's. A Sharpen also waits in your hand for a blade, as the bot keeps it, so a deck with Sharpens and no blade holds them all battle, a card short in hand (the last deck above). The simulator's notes say so on the command line (python vision\battlesim.py --deck ...): "4 Sharpen cards and no blade in the deck: held all battle, ... - useblades off for this deck throws them away" (with `discardunused` off nothing throws them, and the note says that instead).
- **Decks without Sharpen or Potent** play exactly as before: 90 random decks (2 to 5 copies of a blade or trap, pet and gear cards, treasure cards, Reshuffles): 1890 simulate (3 seeds and 7 sets of settings a deck), 450 planner, 90 team plan and 90 deck pick comparisons against v1.8.1, 0 differing. Only the simulator's "not modelled" note reads differently: it names the enemies' cheats where it named Sharpen and Potent.
- **The planner.** Its tries cast a blade or trap sharpened while a Sharpen (a Potent) is in your hand and that blade's sharpened cast is free; a deck copy (which takes the Sharpen) is tried apart from a pet's or gear's copy (which doesn't). The Sharpen itself is no play of its own (the helper's /plan answer notes "1 card in hand not tried (goes on a blade)"), and the advice's reasons start "with Sharpened Blade" (debug.log "Plan: would play Stormblade on you (won ...; with Sharpened Blade, ...)"). This AutoFarmer now sends which blades and traps it sharpened this battle (`used1=`), so the planner doesn't try sharpening one twice.
- **Mixed versions are fine.** An older AutoFarmer with this helper: its simulator plays Sharpen and Potent too (that bot plays them the same way in the game, as every AutoFarmer since v0.50.0 does), and the planner works out the sharpened casts from the "+" blades and traps on, while your hand or worn deck holds a Sharpen (a Potent). Once a hit has used up a sharpened blade it can't see that one, so its tries may sharpen it again (advice only). This AutoFarmer with an older helper: `used1=` is ignored, and that helper plays as before.
- **Not tried in the game.** Nothing new happens in the game: the bot plays its cards as before and only sends the helper one more thing (`used1=`). Not checked in the game yet: the real Sharpen and Potent % (the simulator takes the card's own number, else 10), whether a sharpened blade stacks with a plain copy of the same blade, and whether a Potent goes on Feint or a Sharpen on Bladestorm. The simulator follows the bot's own bookkeeping, so if the game differs, both are wrong the same way.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
